subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire the shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` value now, with doctor removing it and selectively persisting `enabled: false` when active OTLP signals would otherwise begin exporting over HTTP?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but automation cannot choose whether a shipped accepted value may become invalid at startup or whether doctor should rewrite the user's enabled setting.

options.title: Approve selective doctor migration
options.body: Accept the retirement policy because it preserves the prior no-OTLP outcome while keeping stdout-only logging enabled.

options.title: Preserve acceptance temporarily
options.body: Keep `grpc` schema compatibility until a longer deprecation window or real gRPC exporter path is approved.

options.title: Remove without disabling
options.body: Have doctor delete only `protocol`, accepting that some repaired configurations would begin exporting through HTTP/protobuf.

recommendation.title: Approve selective doctor migration
recommendation.body: Accept the retirement policy because it preserves the prior no-OTLP outcome while keeping stdout-only logging enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: This cross-cutting shipped-config and upgrade-policy choice needs repository-level ownership beyond routine contributor follow-up.
